summary: Report chain startup before checking mining resource limits and explain preflight output
details: Mining preflight reports CHAIN_NOT_RUNNING with container and process observations plus retry guidance before checking runtime resource limits.
Absent containers no longer look like unbounded-memory containers; running chains retain memory and CPU eligibility checks.
The operator handbook explains mining eligibility, amount units, global supply inputs, conditional first-block issuance estimates, bootstrap progress, and startup troubleshooting.
operator_actions: Use the updated node tools for corrected startup diagnostics; wait for chain startup before retrying mining check or enable.
